paite: Huan Ahab in Elijah thilhih tengteng, namsau a zawlnei tengteng athah thute toh Jezebel ahilh hi.
heading: Sinai Tang Ah Elijah

paite: Huchi in Jezebel in Elijah kiang ah, "Huai mite lak a mi khat hinna bang a zingchiang a hichi hun ma a na hinna ka hon bawlsak sam keileh pathiante'n alohloh uh hon loh uhenla, huai sang a sezaw in leng,” chi a hilh ding in mi asawl hi.
Huchi in huai atheih in alau a, athou a, ahinna humbit ding in atai hi. Judah gam a Beer-sheba khua ava tung a, huai ah asikha anusia hi.
Amah gamdai ah ni khat lampaina tan ah ahoh a, Juniper sing nuai ah tu in sih angenta hi. "Ahunta; TOUPA aw, tu in ka hinna la in, ka pute sang in lah ka hoihzaw tuan kei," achi hi.
Juniper sing nuai ah alum a, a-ihmuta hi. Ngai in, angel in ahong khoih a, akiang ah, "Thou inla ne in," achi hi.
Ama'n a-en vialvial a, ngai in, alu chin ah tanghou pei, suangsa a haiminsa leh tuithawl ana om hi. Huchi in hiaite ne in adawn a, alum nawn hi.
Anihveina ding in TOUPA angel ahong pai nawn a, ahong khoih a, "Thou inla, ne in, na paina ding agamla lo lai hi,” achi hi.
Huchi in athou a, ne in adawn a, an ziak a hatna in Pathian tang Horeb tan ni sawmli leh zan sawmli apai hi.
Huai a kokhuk khat ava tung a, huai ah a-omta hi. Ngai in, TOUPA thu akiang ah ahong tung a, akiang ah, "Hiai a bang hih na hia, Elijah?" achi hi.

Ama'n, "TOUPA, Sepaihte' Pathian a ding in phatuam ka ngai mahmah hi. Israel suante'n lah na thukhun alehngatsan ua, na maitamte achimsak ua, na zawlneite namsau in athat ua; a-om lai kei ka hi a, ka hinna lakmang ding in azong uh," achi hi.

Ama'n, "Pawtkhia inla, huai tang ah TOUPA ma ah va dingh in," achi hi. Ngai in, TOUPA ahong pai a, huihpi hat mahmah in tangte TOUPA ma ah amutkhang a, suangpi akitam phuakphuak hi. Himahleh huai ah TOUPA a-om kei. Huih nun khit in zin ahong ling a; himahleh huai zinling ah TOUPA a-om kei.
Zinlin khit in meikuang ahong pawt a; himahleh huai mei ah TOUPA a-om kei. Meikuang nung in aw ngat ngiingei ahong pawt hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, Elijah in huai azak in apuanin amai akhuh a, va pawtkhia in kokhuk lutna ah ava dingh hi. Ngai in, huai aw in akiang ah, "Hiai a bang hih na hia, Elijah?" achi hi.

Ama'n, "TOUPA, Sepaihte' Pathian a ding in phatuam ka ngai mahmah hi. Israel suante'n lah na thukhun alehngatsan ua, na maitamte achimsak ua, na zawlneite namsau in athat ua. A-om lai kei ka hi a, ka hinna lakmang ding in azong uh," achi hi.
TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Pai nawn inla, gamdai lam a Damaskas ah pai in. Na tun chiang in Siria kumpipa ding in Hazael thau na nilh ding hi.
Israel kumpipa ding in Nimshi tapa Jehu thau na nilh ding; na sik a zawlnei ding in Abel-meholah a mi Shaphat tapa Elisha leng thau na nilh ding ahi.
Huan hichi ahi ding a, Hazael namsau pel peuhmah Jehu in athat dia; Jehu namsau pel peuhmah Elisha in athat ding.
Himahleh Israel gam ah Baal ma a khukdin ngei lou leh amah tawp ngeiloumi sangsagih kei a ding in ka sit hi," achi hi.

Huchi in huai a pan apawtkhia a, Shaphat tapa Elisha ava mukhia hi. Ama'n langkawn bat bawngtal tuak sawm-le-nih in lou ana kai hi. Asawm-le-nihna azang hi. Elijah in ava naih a, apuan ava silhsak hi.
heading: Elisha Sapna

paite: Ama'n abawngtalte paisan in Elijah anungdelh a, "Ka nu leh ka pa hon tawpsak ding in ka hon ngen, huchi in ka hon zui ding," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Pai nawn ve le, bang ka hon chih a eita?" achi hi.
Amah zui lai akik nawn a, bawng tuakkhat agou a, bawng vante in asa ahuan a, mite apia a, amau ane uhi. Huchi in athou a, Elijah adelh a, a-nna asepsakta hi.
